payload.title: PReSto2k Climate Field Reconstruction Project
payload.summary: The PReSto2k Climate Field Reconstruction Project aims to assemble, assimilate, and validate paleoclimate data for climate reconstructions over the past two millennia. The project involves three main phases: data assembly, data assimilation, and validation. Each phase consists of specific tasks executed through Jupyter notebooks, leveraging various datasets and computational techniques to achieve comprehensive climate reconstructions.

phases.role: Assemble proxy databases from various sources, ensuring data quality and readiness for assimilation.
Integrate and process assembled data to produce climate field reconstructions using advanced statistical methods.
Evaluate and validate the reconstructed climate data against established baselines and instrumental records.

end_to_end_steps.title: Assembling the proxy database from the LiPDVerse
end_to_end_steps.description: Assemble a proxy database from the LiPDVerse, focusing on data querying and cleaning.

end_to_end_steps.title: Correlating two GeoSeries
end_to_end_steps.description: Compute the correlation between two GeoSeries using the pyleoclim library.

end_to_end_steps.title: Assembling the proxy database from the LiPDGraph
end_to_end_steps.description: Query the LiPDGraph database to assemble a proxy database for data assimilation.

end_to_end_steps.title: Plotting as a GeoSeries Dashboard
end_to_end_steps.description: Explore and visualize a subset of LiPD datasets using Pyleoclim.

end_to_end_steps.title: Run Data Assimilation (Individual Seasonality)
end_to_end_steps.description: Perform data assimilation for climate reconstruction using the LMRv2.1 framework.

end_to_end_steps.title: Proxy Database Comparisons
end_to_end_steps.description: Compare proxy databases before and after interpolation to understand reconstruction differences.

end_to_end_steps.title: Loading LiPDverse Data and Plotting as GeoSeries
end_to_end_steps.description: Load paleoclimate datasets from the LiPDverse and create a Pyleoclim GeoSeries.

end_to_end_steps.title: Validating PReSto2k
end_to_end_steps.description: Validate the PReSto2k reconstructions by comparing them against the LMRv2.1 baseline.
